title: Donidin's Devastating Weapons
description: Adds a bunch of different cool weapons with their own special features.
body:
# Donidin's Devastating Weapons

## Description:
This mod adds unique weapons with interesting mechanics to Minecraft. Each item has its own role, effect, and balance, turning ordinary battles into more strategic and varied ones.

## Features:

- Cactus Sword — inflicts poison for a short time, easy to craft
- Ice Blade — slows down and weakens enemies
- Vampire Axe — heals when attacking with restrictions
- Mighty Axe — allows for a dash followed by slowdown and cooldown
- Explosive Sword — throws dynamite with cooldown and limited durability
- Star Axe — chance to summon lightning, high durability
- Scythe of Death — deals high damage with a wither effect, risk to the owner

## FAQ & Licensing
- Can I include this mod in my modpack?

Yes! You are free to include this mod in any modpack, provided that the mod is downloaded from official source.

- Can I create add-ons for this mod?

Absolutely! I encourage creating and publishing add-ons or compatibility patches that require this mod to function. You don't need to ask for permission for this.

- Can I redistribute or re-upload this mod?

No. You are not allowed to host the mod files on other websites or redistrubute them. Please always link back to the official Modrinth page.

- Can I modify the source code?

No. Modification of the source code and publishing "forks" or edited versions of this mod is strictly prohibited under the current license.
